summary: Sawyer County, WI: a 100-foot Aermotor lookout built in 1934 and administered by the Wisconsin DNR; the Forest Fire Lookout Association now lists it as gone.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor tower with a US Forest Service-style stairway
facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. No source describes what stands at the site today.

evidence.supports: 100-foot Aermotor tower with a US Forest Service-style stairway, built 1934
evidence.quote: This 100-foot Aermotor tower features a US Forest Service-style stairway. It was built in 1934.

evidence.supports: administered by the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources
evidence.quote: Administered by Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources

evidence.supports: listed as gone in the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Wisconsin list
evidence.quote: Meteor Sawyer 45.69330 -91.34776 Tower Gone NHLR US 1215, WI 21

evidence.supports: a weather map page is titled Meteor Hills Radio Tower; its address places it in Sawyer County
evidence.quote: Yr - Meteor Hills Radio Tower - Weather map

sources.title: Meteor Hills Radio Tower weather map

notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list says gone; the NHLR description is in the present tense and gives no removal date. Map listings for 'Meteor Hills Radio Tower' at 45.69333, -91.3475 (getamap.net and anyplaceamerica.com, seen only as search snippets; both returned HTTP 403 to fetch) would sit about 20 m from the record point. They are not cited in the story and need a human check before anyone says what stands there. NHLR does not name the tower's material; the record's 'steel' is from the design field and is unverified. A search snippet from the NHLR Camp Douglas entry says Wisconsin decommissioned its lookout network in 2015; that is about another tower and is not used.
